units: Y. Yoma III, 40ᵈ bot.; Pes. 50ᵃ (ref. to לעלם, Ex. II, 15) לע׳ כתיב it is so written that you may read l’‘elem (this is my name for secrecy).—Pl. עֲלָמוֹת.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:21">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 1</cite> (play on <cite ref="P00825"><he>עלמות</he></cite>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:21">ib.</cite>) <he>על הע׳ שהבן עושה וכ׳</he> on the secret sins which the child (of God) commits and which the Day of Atonement comes to atone for &c.
